title: Tablettes Albertini. Actes privés de l’époque vandale (fin du Ve siècle)
bibliographicNote: Latin transcriptions with French editorial commentary. Document XIII, pp. 259–261, records a sale by Processanus and Siddina and the closing subscription by Donatianus. The edition signals gaps and reconstructed letters.
publisher: Arts et métiers graphiques (Paris), digitised text hosted by Université Grenoble Alpes
